configuration.scope: Column-anchored Gaussian screens: sigma 10 rad/m^2 (Hutschenreuter high-latitude rms), structure function 2 sigma^2 [1-exp(-(chord/theta0)^alpha)] with theta0 set by the rms depth difference at 1 degree (0.3, 1, 3 rad/m^2) for alpha 2 and 5/3, matching the main pilot (scripts/faraday_redistribution.py). mean_depth 0: the smooth term exp(-2 sigma^2 x^2) vanishes at every LuSEE frequency for this sigma. The posterior-mean anchor overstates coherence, so these are the upper end of the column model. Same intrinsic sky, beam kernels and gates as covariance.json.

scope: Conditional foreground-screen second moments and Gaussian visibility illustrations. Intrinsic amplitude, E/B spectra, local angular screen and low-frequency turnover are assumed. Mixed-depth real-beam projection, leakage and loaded receiver noise are pending; no LuSEE sensitivity claim is made.
